author: potuz
content: if you guys do go with this, can you make this please 3 instead of 5?  There is no practical reason to have more than parent full empty or grandparent already solved by forkchoice. author: potuz
content: I think you may be confusing something which is the reason why I am mildly against this change: no one is prohibiting p2p builders to send many bids! if there are different viable heads, then different peers will propagate different bids. The proposer will get the best one that is compatible with the heads from their peers. So multiple heads is already supported by the current design. What you are changing is on the verification side which I believe it's unnecessary, it's useless to send different bids if every peer is on the same head and will be verifying unnecessarily a useless bid. So this feature is already covered in the only case that it is needed: when different peers are on different heads. For my statement to be true however we should make peers only forward bids that are compatible with their head view, which I think it's the intent of the design and should be the correct thing.

author: nflaig
content: if even all nodes in the network have the same head view at slot `N` and builder bidding for `N+1` might still wanna provide 3 bids assuming that payload was revelead, so let's assume block `B` is for slot `N`, you still wanna bid for `(B, FULL)` and `(B, EMPTY)` and to cover proposer boost reorg also for `B - 1` (the payload status there is resolved by weight already). it doesn't matter what's the head view of the network is here as the decision depends solely on the proposer, you can observe attestations and ptc votes to make the right call most of the time and submit the bid the proposer will likely go with, but just the fact that proposer boost reorg is optional already makes this hard to predict
